neighbours.label: the verb tokens ' runs' / ' running' / ' ran' / ' approached' (esp. 'who runs X')
fire: My aunt is the woman who runs the bakery on Elm Street.
Their company runs three hotels near the harbour.
The old man slowly approached the gate and knocked twice.
She has been running the shelter for almost ten years.
Last summer he ran a small bookshop in the village.
A nonprofit that runs art classes for children opened nearby.
Two officers approached the car with their lights on.
Whoever runs this website should fix the broken links.
quiet: My aunt is the woman who owns the bakery on Elm Street.
Their company bought three hotels near the harbour.
The old man slowly opened the gate and knocked twice.
She has been helping the shelter for almost ten years.
Last summer he visited a small bookshop in the village.
A nonprofit that offers art classes for children opened nearby.
Two officers stopped beside the car with their lights on.
Whoever made this website should fix the broken links.

notes: card flags broad (1.7%); ' runs' is the commonest top token
